name: two_a
intro: A two-stage lock. Clear both modules to escape.
manual:
PANEL MANUAL

MODULE 1 - WIRES
Cut exactly one wire:
- If there are three or more wires, cut the BLUE wire.
- Otherwise, cut the FIRST wire.

MODULE 2 - KEYPAD
One symbol glows above the keypad. Enter its code:
- star: 1111
- moon: 2222
- sun: 3333

modules.title: A bundle of wires
modules.observation: Four wires, left to right: red, blue, green, yellow.

modules.title: A symbol keypad
modules.observation: A keypad with a single glowing MOON symbol above it.
